items.rationale: The bathtub supply leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2, and §7.1.7(a) covers removal of the damaged flooring. The 18 m² line is estimated at €583 gross using the matched price prior.

items.description: Install living-room laminate and sound underlay
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like laminate and equivalent underlay, not the premium oak upgrade. Case 61 supports €1,350 gross for the full 18 m² at the pre-loss standard.

Section 7.1.7 covers damaged trim and trim that must be removed and cannot be refitted; §7.1.9 excludes the solid-oak upgrade cost. Case 61 supports €850 gross for 25 linear metres of equivalent skirting.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged bathroom tiles
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers dismantling and disposal because the entire bathroom floor was affected. The matched price prior gives €366 gross for 6 m².

items.description: Supply and install bathroom floor tiles
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 limit payment to tiles and installation equivalent to the pre-loss floor, excluding the premium large-format porcelain uplift. Case 61 supports €950 gross for 6 m² of like-for-like supply and installation, with removal priced separately.

Section 7.1.8(a) excludes general cleaning, and this flat rate does not isolate covered repair debris or residue removal. The conditional €100 gross estimate reflects only a necessary, documented cleanup of the affected work area.

items.description: Prepare and repaint water-damaged lower wall
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) cover preparation and repainting of the affected lower wall along the partition. The matched price prior gives €858 gross for 20 m².
The ceiling was dry and no work was done there; §§7.1.5–7.1.6 also rule out extending the wall repair to this separate surface. The €180 gross figure is conditional on proof of covered ceiling work.
The hallway was dry and no work was done there, so §§7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude it from the repair. The €270 gross figure is conditional on proof of covered wallpapering for the 8 m² line.
